body:
Slice 2 of 7 of #636. Depends on #654. Fold into it only if the pair stays within the ~1,500 added-semantic-line budget.

## What

The ~31 `MAX_*` / window / backoff constants with the derivation in each doc comment (`MAX_MAP_CHUNKS`, `MAX_SEG_CHUNKS`, `MAX_PART_CHUNKS`, `MAX_PARTS_PER_SESSION`, `MAX_INFLIGHT_PARTS`, `MAX_STAGED_CHUNKS`, `W_REF`, retry/backoff bounds, `Budget`), plus `knob_clamps_hold` asserting the inequalities between them — the caps are enforced in this seam's code, so this seam picks the values, each as a named constant with its derivation.

## Acceptance

- every constant's derivation stated in its doc comment and consistent with the code (no /2-vs-/4 drift); `knob_clamps_hold` green;
- `cargo xtask ci` green.

Part of #636 / #508 / epic #513.

milestone.title: 0.1 Alpha
milestone.description: First tagged release (Alpha). Scheduled after the two production-metadata milestones complete: #14 (Metadata Store FoundationDB) and #5 (M4 — Production metadata backend) — i.e. after the FDB go/no-go (#442) records go, the default flips to FDB, and TiKV development stands down (#443). No due date yet; it follows those two. Starts empty as the release marker.
